senses.gloss: f. (חכן, cmp. עכן) ḥăkhina, name of a large snake, prob. annulated snake.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:20">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ</cite> bot. (in Chald. dict.), v. <cite ref="G00105"><he>זְהַר</he></cite>. Ib. VIII, 12ᵇ; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:15">Gen. R. s. 82</cite>, end (<cite ref="Chullin 127a">Ḥull. 127ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="N00519"><he>נחש</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:15">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> top <he>כרִיסָהּ של ח׳</he> (not <he>ככריסה</he>) like the venom of a ḥ.; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:4">Ruth R. to III, 13</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> top <he>ח׳ כריכה עליו</he> (read: <he>כרוכה</he>) a snake wound around him; (<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>עכנא כריכא</he>).—Pl. <he>חֲכִינִים</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8:1">Cant. R. to VII, 8</cite> [read:] <he>חבר שהיה לו שתי ח׳</he> a charmer who had two snakes.
